steps.speaker: Sovereign Duck
steps.content: Quack... Quack quack quack quack quack quack quack... (No... were all the things in the books really just lies...?)

After the situation was resolved, the Bureau conducted tests on the confiscated instant cameras and photos, confirming the presence of trace amounts of Mania elements in them. The ducks were already mentally unstable after working so much, and this became the final straw that pushed them over the edge.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We've already performed special cleaning on the problematic cameras and photos. However, during the final recovery and inventory, staff reported that far fewer photos were recovered than initially recorded—and the vast majority of the missing ones are yours, Chief...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Go ask K.K. —she might have some idea where the photos ended up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Most importantly, we need to keep stepping up our Mania detection, and also make sure we're managing the ducks' workload properly. Plus, we can't let up on reviewing the content of the books we purchase.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I really didn't expect this incident would take up so much time. Looks like I'll have to miss those social obligations originally scheduled for this weekend.

Nightingale stands to the side, holding a stack of documents, watching you with something clearly on her mind but hesitating to speak. Her gaze makes you feel a bit guilty—you can't shake the feeling that your dear adjutant has seen right through your attempts to avoid work ever since the duck attack began.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, I'm letting this one slide, but it must never happen again. If you're ever faced with an unreasonable work schedule, do not put yourself in danger just to buy time.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Next time, please let me know first— I'll find a way to help you.
